45 PowerShell Commands. One Goal.

I built a PowerShell module specifically around endpoint security.

The result?

45 commands designed to address endpoint issues identified through Microsoft Secure Score and other Windows security products.

This is one of the things I enjoy about PowerShell.

It isn't just scripting.

It's the ability to take a security recommendation and turn it into something that can actually be implemented, automated and repeated.

That's where coding and cybersecurity meet.

And that's exactly where I like working.

Full Deets: https://wadebach.blackcatwhitehatsecurity.com/code.cfm
